description:
## [0.0.17](https://github.com/FarhanZafarr-9/InstaPrime/releases/tag/v0.0.17) (2026-10-29)

## My settings UI rework

I made InstaPrime as a personal UI rework of HushGram. This is about my own interface preferences, not a critique of the original design.

All Instagram patch functionality, research, compatibility work, and ongoing upstream maintenance credit belongs to SysAdminDoc and the upstream contributors. My changes focus on settings navigation, rows, switches, dialogs, and InstaPrime branding.

### Changes

- Category pages and nested groups with back navigation and restored scroll positions.
- Borderless rounded rows, more spacing, full descriptions, and bounded ripples.
- Wallpaper-derived settings colors on Android 12 and newer.
- Animated circular switch thumbs, on-state checkmarks, and distinct disabled states.
- Redesigned choice dialogs, text fields, stacked actions, and restart notice.
- Enable all controls on pages with direct toggle options.
- Fork information with original creator credits and support links.
- InstaPrime icons and clone defaults: InstaPrime / com.instagram.android.prime.

### Bundle

Built from commit 62d382f8 on top of HushGram 0.0.17. Contains 123 patches for Instagram 453.0.0.55.79. The .mpp is a Morphe patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. The SBOM, build information, and SHA-256 checksums are attached.

### Validation

The clean source build passed bundle integrity verification for 123 patches and all three non-empty DEX payloads. During UI development, 44 focused settings tests passed on Android API 28 and 37.

I manually tested the UI rework and approved this release. The inherited automated whole-app walkthrough and full fixture release gate were not run for this fork release.

### Maintenance and credit

I work on this in my available time, so adapting future upstream updates may be significantly delayed. If you need the newest patches promptly, please use the original HushGram project.

Original project: https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram
Original creator: https://github.com/SysAdminDoc
Support the original creator: https://ko-fi.com/X8K126YVER
